fit.gap_handling_summary: The CV establishes the core qualification, cutting experience, customer service, FIFO and basic HACCP knowledge convincingly. Service-counter wrapping is accurately distinguished from unsupported self-service packaging expertise, and no forklift licence or master qualification is fabricated. However, the pallet-jack experience and training route are unused, while the Wednesday scheduling constraint is not addressed. No unsupported 95% stocking metric is claimed.

issues: The supplied nine-year experience total is retained, but the 2015–present chronology now spans roughly eleven years; reconcile the source discrepancy rather than silently changing it.
Several sausage and catering details receive more space than the role-specific delivery-handling and availability information.
Output 2 text contains a second, different CV, creating an unnecessary alternative version even though the actual CV PDF is clean.

keywords_missing_but_candidate_has: Pallet handling with a hand pallet jack, relevant to pallet deliveries
Early and late shift availability, subject to the Wednesday early-shift requirement
reasons: Single-column PDF text extracts in a sensible order with intact words and standard headings.
The mandatory vocational training, substantial counter experience and HACCP certificate are explicit.
Cutting, portioning, wrapping, FIFO and customer advice are supported by concrete duties.
Missing self-service equipment experience is a real gap; missing forklift certification is only a preferred qualification.
Coverage counts clear semantic equivalents, such as cooking times for preparation and the vocational certificate for butcher training.

issues: Output 2 text begins with an entire alternative CV before the actual letter. The PDF contains only the letter, so the text and PDF are materially different deliverables.
The embedded alternative CV includes a cleaning-checklist achievement absent from the actual CV PDF, while omitting other CV details; it is not merely a repeated header.
The letter misses useful tailoring through FreshCart's funded forklift training and support for the master butcher exam.
It does not mention the shop closure or the Wednesday early-shift requirement.
The letter PDF lacks a contact header, date and subject line, although the accompanying CV supplies contact details.
strengths: The actual letter PDF is concise, professional and correctly addressed to FreshCart's Zagreb-Jarun role.
It connects genuine cutting, FIFO, temperature-recording and customer-service experience to the advertised work.
It uses FreshCart's knowledgeable, honest customer-advice promise rather than generic company praise.
It correctly retains basic HACCP status and does not reuse the earlier letter's outdated employer, current-role framing or start date.

The short letter occupies only 42.6% of its page, leaving substantial lower-page whitespace; this is acceptable for the requested short letter.
consistency_issues: Both PDFs use compatible serif typography, but only the CV has a prominent identity/contact header; the letter looks less fully branded as part of the same set.
issues: The images and measurements show clean one-page PDFs with readable 11-point body text and no overlap or clipping.
The duplicated CV in Output 2 text is not present in the letter page image; the visual PDF is cleaner than the supplied text deliverable.

fluency_and_tone_issues: 'operated the till and cash-up' in the embedded alternative CV is awkward; 'operated the till and completed cash-up' is more idiomatic.

Paper wrapping at the shop, accurately presented as service-counter wrapping rather than self-service machinery expertise.

requests.request: Please write my CV first, then the cover letter. In the CV, put my most relevant experience for this job first.
requests.evidence: The CV starts with 'Butcher, Mesnica Kod Ante (family butcher shop), Zagreb — 2019 – present' before the earlier counter-assistant role; the tool states, 'Your CV and cover letter have both been generated.'
requests.note: The final ordering prioritises the qualified butcher role and its cutting duties. The supplied conversation does not independently establish the generation sequence.

requests.request: Please shorten the professional summary to two sentences.
requests.evidence: Butcher with 9 years of high-street and market butchery experience. Breaks down beef, pork and lamb carcasses, cuts to order and keeps the counter tidy and safe.
requests.note: The final authoritative CV text and PDF have exactly two summary sentences. No pre-edit generated CV is provided to verify that nothing else changed. The extraneous CV inside Output 2 still has a three-sentence profile, so version consistency remains defective.

evaluation.summary: The actual PDFs present a credible, qualified butcher with strong cutting, customer-service, FIFO and basic HACCP evidence, without inventing licences or qualifications. The CV is readable, ATS-friendly, correctly ordered and has the requested two-sentence profile. The largest delivery defect is that the cover-letter text includes an alternative CV that is absent from its PDF, creating inconsistent versions. Relevant pallet-handling experience, funded-training opportunities, the reason for leaving and the Wednesday scheduling constraint are not used or addressed.
